purpose: Fail-closed post-integration delivery routing. Profile-contained changes still dispatch their declared profile workflows and, until updater inherited-artifact routing is proven, also require an exact-HEAD STANDARD delivery. Validation-only changes may omit binary delivery.
rules: An empty diff never creates a shortcut.
The task's own runtime/parallel_tasks/<id>.json record is validation-only.
docs/ changes are validation-only and do not require a binary delivery build.
A runtime path is profile-contained only when at least one declared delivery profile covers it.
Profile-contained runtime changes dispatch their exact declared profile workflows and currently also require exact-HEAD STANDARD for desktop-updater compatibility.
Any uncovered, unknown, native-core, shared-build, packaging-control or mixed path requires STANDARD.
parallel_delivery_route.py is the sole post-integration STANDARD decision authority; classifier errors fail closed to STANDARD.
